name: wisscreen
description: WICLOUD is a Next.js 16 (App Router) marketing site and platform for an IT solutions agency: a long-form marketing homepage with per-solution landing pages, plus a back-office platform (/dashboard, /admin) built on Neon Postgres, Better Auth, and Drizzle ORM. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
